content.json:
# Answer review
Use this page to review **one answer** or **one whole chat** in the Bank Manager governance demo.

1. In the demo, open **IDs and observability links** under an answer.
2. Copy the **Trace ID** (one answer) or the **Conversation ID** (the whole chat), and paste it below. Or select a row in **Recent answers**.

A trace ID is the W3C trace ID. Application Insights stores it as the operation ID (`operation_Id`). Telemetry never holds the question, the answer, or account data. **Decision** shows what the policy did: `allowed`, `approval_required`, `denied_expected` (the rules blocked something they should block) or `denied_unexpected` (something broke, so look into it). `not_checked` is the no-rules lane, shown for comparison.

This page is defined in `infra/dashboards/answer-review.workbook.json`. Change that file, not only the portal. See the `eps-demo-telemetry-links` skill.

**Two lanes.** Every answer runs twice: once with **no rules** (unsafe on purpose) and once **governed by policy**. Each lane is its own branch of the trace (`lane baseline` and `lane governed`), so the tables below split the work by lane.

## Recent answers
Every answer that recorded a conversation ID. Select a row to review that answer below.

content.query:
let lanes = dependencies
    | where name startswith "lane "
    | extend d = customDimensions, Lane = tostring(customDimensions["demo.lane"])
    | extend Summary = strcat(tostring(d["demo.status"]), iff(tostring(d["demo.tool_executed"]) =~ "true", " · tool ran", " · tool did not run"), " · ", tostring(d["demo.reason"]))
    | summarize ["No rules"] = take_anyif(Summary, Lane == "baseline"), Governed = take_anyif(Summary, Lane == "governed") by operation_Id;
requests
| where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.conversation.id"]))
| where name has "compare"
| summarize Started = min(timestamp), ["Seconds"] = round(max(duration) / 1000, 1), ["Failed steps"] = countif(success == false), Conversation = take_any(tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.conversation.id"])), Mode = take_any(tostring(customDimensions["demo.mode"])), Version = take_any(application_Version) by TraceId = operation_Id
| top 50 by Started desc
| join kind=leftouter lanes on $left.TraceId == $right.operation_Id
| project-away operation_Id
| project Started, TraceId, ["No rules"], Governed, Seconds, ["Failed steps"], Conversation, Mode, Version
content.title: Recent answers, with both lanes (select a row)
content.noDataMessage: No answers yet. Ask a question in the demo, then refresh.

content.json:
## One answer
The two lanes side by side, where the time went, every step grouped by lane, and anything that failed.

content.query:
let traceId = trim(" ", "{TraceId}");
dependencies
| where operation_Id == traceId and name startswith "lane "
| extend d = customDimensions
| project Lane = tostring(d["demo.lane.label"]), Tool = tostring(d["gen_ai.tool.name"]), ["Tool ran"] = tostring(d["demo.tool_executed"]), Result = tostring(d["demo.status"]), Rule = tostring(d["demo.reason"]), ["Policy checks"] = tostring(d["demo.policy_checks"]), Decision = tostring(d["demo.authz.outcome"]), Seconds = round(duration / 1000, 3), timestamp
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: The two lanes, side by side
content.noDataMessage: No lane spans for this answer. Answers recorded before lane tracing show their steps below instead.

content.query:
let traceId = trim(" ", "{TraceId}");
union requests, dependencies
| where operation_Id == traceId
| summarize Seconds = round(sum(duration) / 1000, 2) by Step = strcat(cloud_RoleName, ": ", name)
| top 15 by Seconds desc
content.title: Where the time went (seconds per step)
content.noDataMessage: No steps found for this trace ID in the selected time range.

content.query:
let traceId = trim(" ", "{TraceId}");
union (exceptions | extend Problem = strcat(type, ": ", outerMessage)), (union requests, dependencies | where success == false | extend Problem = strcat(name, " returned ", resultCode))
| where operation_Id == traceId
| project timestamp, Service = cloud_RoleName, Problem
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Problems in this answer
content.noDataMessage: No failed steps or exceptions in this answer.

content.query:
let traceId = trim(" ", "{TraceId}");
union requests, dependencies, traces, exceptions, customEvents
| where operation_Id == traceId
| extend lane = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["demo.lane"]), tostring(customDimensions["lane"]))
| extend Lane = case(lane == "baseline", "No rules", lane == "governed", "Governed", "Shared")
| extend Order = case(Lane == "Shared", 0, Lane == "No rules", 1, 2)
| extend Step = coalesce(name, message, type), Seconds = round(duration / 1000, 2), Decision = tostring(customDimensions["demo.authz.outcome"]), Rule = tostring(customDimensions["demo.reason"])
| order by Order asc, timestamp asc
| project Lane, timestamp, Kind = itemType, Step, Decision, Rule, Seconds, Succeeded = success, Code = resultCode, SpanId = id, ParentId = operation_ParentId
content.title: Every step in this answer, grouped by lane
content.noDataMessage: No steps found for this trace ID in the selected time range.

content.json:
## One conversation
Every answer in the same chat, as one summary row and as a list.

content.query:
let conversationId = trim(" ", "{ConversationId}");
let traces = requests
    | where tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.conversation.id"]) == conversationId
    | distinct operation_Id;
union requests, dependencies
| where operation_Id in (traces)
| summarize Questions = dcountif(operation_Id, itemType == 'request' and name has 'compare'), Approvals = dcountif(operation_Id, itemType == 'request' and name has 'approval'), Started = min(timestamp), Ended = max(timestamp), Models = make_set_if(tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.model"]), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.model"]))), ["Input tokens"] = sum(tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"])), ["Output tokens"] = sum(tolong(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])), Decisions = make_set_if(tostring(customDimensions["demo.authz.outcome"]), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["demo.authz.outcome"]))), ["No-rules tool runs"] = countif(name == "lane baseline" and tostring(customDimensions["demo.tool_executed"]) =~ "true"), ["Governed tool runs"] = countif(name == "lane governed" and tostring(customDimensions["demo.tool_executed"]) =~ "true"), ["Governed blocks"] = countif(name == "lane governed" and tostring(customDimensions["demo.status"]) == "deny"), ["Failed steps"] = countif(success == false), TraceIds = make_set(operation_Id, 100)
content.title: Whole chat, one row
content.noDataMessage: No answers found for this conversation ID in the selected time range.

content.query:
let lanes = dependencies
    | where name startswith "lane "
    | extend d = customDimensions, Lane = tostring(customDimensions["demo.lane"])
    | extend Summary = strcat(tostring(d["demo.status"]), iff(tostring(d["demo.tool_executed"]) =~ "true", " · tool ran", " · tool did not run"), " · ", tostring(d["demo.reason"]))
    | summarize ["No rules"] = take_anyif(Summary, Lane == "baseline"), Governed = take_anyif(Summary, Lane == "governed") by operation_Id;
let conversationId = trim(" ", "{ConversationId}");
requests
| where tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.conversation.id"]) == conversationId
| summarize Started = min(timestamp), Seconds = round(max(duration) / 1000, 1), ["Failed steps"] = countif(success == false), Kind = take_any(iff(name has "approval", "Approve or Reject", "Question")) by TraceId = operation_Id
| order by Started asc
| join kind=leftouter lanes on $left.TraceId == $right.operation_Id
| project-away operation_Id
| project Started, Kind, TraceId, ["No rules"], Governed, Seconds, ["Failed steps"]
| order by Started asc
content.title: Answers in this chat (select a row to review it above)
content.noDataMessage: No answers found for this conversation ID in the selected time range.
